# Gemini CLI Skills

## Overview

Gemini CLI supports Agent Skills defined by `SKILL.md`.

## Locations

- `~/.gemini/skills/` (global)
- `.gemini/skills/` (workspace)
- Extensions can also supply skills

## Sources

- https://geminicli.com/docs/cli/skills/
